title: Keep: bridge judges nothing, git vouch query decides
description:
git-vouch-trqp:202-254. The bridge shells out to `git vouch query` and maps only its documented contract: exit 0 or 1 with a JSON object is an answer, and anything else (OSError, timeout, other exit code, unparseable output) is a retryable unavailable. decide() adds only policy that belongs to the bridge (authority, action, did:key shape, automation, endorsed email). It never reads registry files.

Do NOT "simplify" this by importing git-vouch's check_registry in-process or by reading people/*.json directly. That creates a second judge of who holds which key, which DESIGN.md's TRQP bridge section rules out, and it loses fail-closed-by-construction: any surprise in the subprocess becomes unavailable, never authorized. If performance needs work, memoize answers above this boundary (vouch-s9w2.1) rather than moving the boundary.
close_reason: Kept (Mark 2026-10-23); boundary stated in git-vouch-trqp query() docstring: speed-ups above it (the per-commit cache), never across
